text: Car Fare Group, the UAE car-rental group behind Car Fare Rent a Car, was founded by Mr. K.S. Bassi and Mrs. Jasbir Bassi; Jasbir Bassi serves as chairperson.
short: Car Fare is a family company founded by K.S. Bassi and Jasbir Bassi.
